reason: The studio's ASSET_CATEGORIES allowlist and type surfaces could not express or see the `friction` kind at all, so valid writes were rejected.
A shipped coverage command parses .tsx as ScriptKind.TS and returns the same understated count to every caller.
An unresolved placeholder convention (ADR-NNNN doubling as a generic pattern token) made a repo-wide substitution write incorrectly into untouched specs.
The shipped build verb adopts and then terminates the launching session's presence declaration, an incorrect write every --real build performs.
Spawned builders ended their turn awaiting a notification instead of polling, stopping before the lane's objective was complete.
The launch path without the package.json tsx loader 500s every API route and emits a misleading error naming a workspace package rather than the missing loader.
The shipped proof command exits 0 with no projects matched, so the CONFIRM_RED gate returns the same vacuous-green halt to any new-package story.
A .strict() wire schema cannot carry an additive producer field, so the record type could not express the data and it was dropped.
A handoff brief's correct-when-written negative existence premise expired via a concurrent sibling, which none of the eighteen modes describes.
check:coverage is shipped tooling that maps contract ids to test titles, so every caller gets the same N/N verdict over unasserted clauses.
The gate's ordering places check:declared after typecheck and all tests, a shipped sequencing choice that makes a ten-second fix cost a full re-run.
The shipped check:mirror-conformance registers only one mirror, so it silently passes over every other re-composed route's drift.
No claim or mutex exists for the friction queue at all, so concurrent adjudicator drains cannot be refused or even warned.
The shipped check scores per-repo rather than per-author drift, reddening the running session's gate for a sibling's edits.
An existing verb fails to resolve the house @path convention and performs a wholesale destructive record replacement.
The install verb registers an enforcement hook by absolute path without verifying the host script exists or is post-flip, reporting a wall that enforces nothing.
Node/pnpm resolution keys off the script's own directory, so a scratchpad-resident script cannot resolve module format or workspace specifiers.
The sheet and delivered PNG dir carry no per-cell record of the code state, so the artifact cannot express which variable each cell varied.
renderArcRollup fixes parked work last behind the entire increment log, so the shipped render hides the actionable section from every reader on a mature arc.
The AUTHOR_TEST phase's 16-turn budget is a shipped default that exhausts on a trivially isolatable two-file unit.
The probe the session used ran and measured a partial activity counter as a proxy for an unchanged picture, validating against the wrong thing.
The authoring session published a steering comparative without checking either half against two artifacts already in the store.
The lifecycle rule reads only the increment log, so chip-carried work is a shape the arc's record type cannot see.
The shipped check reports only staleness while already holding the budget fact, giving every caller a routine-looking red whose documented remedy is wrong.
No edge, tag or rung exists that can detect one ADR's build address being semantically falsified by a later infrastructure ADR.
gate:bg's detach is not a true detach — it holds stdout open under a pipe, so the launcher's own design kills the run silently.
The pass's own verify.py check ran but asked about the branch diff rather than the promise it meant to fence, so it was wrong only as this author wrote it.
No kind-agnostic text search over the corpus exists, so the sweep needed to prove absence cannot be performed at all.
The shared harness's non-vacuity guard counts opaque pixels, returning the same false clean verdict to every caller whose prop stopped drawing.
A Linux-CI-only rmdir race in temp-fixture teardown reds branches that touch nothing near it and cannot reproduce on the dev platform.
capture.mjs hardcodes a steady-state 30s goto budget with no override, a bad default that refuses on every fresh worktree's cold transform.
Bun is installed but absent from the dev box's PATH, so the machine rather than the repository's code takes the gate red.
The shipped uat run path passes its observe runner unmemoized, re-running the identical deterministic command once per leg for every caller.
A shipped probe observes a retired credential location and prints a fix hint prescribing a forbidden action, failing every correctly provisioned box.
The shipped rerun comparison asserts 'nothing was fixed' from git alone, returning a confidently wrong flake verdict for every store-reading rung.
The session's own measurement instrument ran with mis-ordered arguments and published plausible numbers, a wrong check specific to how this agent wrote it.
The rung's shipped closing message names only two remedies and omits the correct third, steering every session it reds toward the wrong fixes.
The driver's COMMITTED_RUNG default builds a URL for an asset that is not in the repo, so the documented reproduce command 404s for every fresh checkout.
The rung fails to take its skip branch on a fresh worktree, reddening the gate identically for any branch regardless of content.
A flag interaction re-arms the parked-entry fence and breaks the documented --discharged-by exemption, with a refusal prescribing a wrong remedy.
